reason: The triclinic cell and Z = 1 are strongly supported by the indexing and peak-position agreement, and the AlCl4/Bi-Se-Br framework is chemically plausible. Exact structure recovery is not sufficiently established: the comparable whole-pattern Rwp report is unavailable, so the claim that 92 peaks match positions validates the lattice but not calculated intensities, coordinates, symmetry, occupancies, or ordering. The trajectory refined a highly flexible P1 model with chemistry restraints; materially different coordinate sets resulted as restraint strength changed, and the selected strongly restrained model had a worse raw profile residual than less-restrained variants. The three submitted CIFs keep the same fixed framework and only place Br on each of three Se/Br sites, with no decisive intensity comparison among them; broader symmetry and framework alternatives were not comparably refined. Physical plausibility therefore does not resolve the coordinate, P1-symmetry, and element-ordering uncertainty, and another scientifically motivated solution/refinement attempt is warranted.
